title: Rule
description: One compliance rule, stored as one YAML file under rules/<ruleset>/ (ROADMAP §5.2). Expressions are Python-syntax strings evaluated only by engine/expr.py (AST whitelist, never eval/exec).

authority.description: Rule set this rule belongs to, e.g. nbc2016 | udcpr2020 | pmc.

overrides.description: Rule id from an earlier rule set that this rule replaces for projects using both sets.

kind.description: 'check' produces pass/fail; 'advisory' produces an obligation the model can't confirm (D23).

for_each.description: Evaluate once per element of this collection; the element is available as `item`.

limit.description: Optional named expression, available to `check` as `limit`.

measured.description: Optional named expression, available to `check` as `measured`.

check.description: Must evaluate to a bool. For advisory rules, True means the obligation is triggered.

message.description: str.format template; may use {measured} and {limit} with format specs.

metric.description: Tag used by the FSI headroom summary (P2.8).

fix_unit.description: Unit shown with fix_by, e.g. 'm', 'm2'. Null = no unit.

guidance_note.description: Note from a reference-only document (e.g. NBCS 2026). Never affects status (D20).
